summary: ServiceCode class and its operations for handling service information related to courses and timetables.
purpose: ServiceCode represents a logical entity for service information, categorized and ordered for course and timetable needs.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Identifier for the category that the code belongs to.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Short name or code for the service.

fields.name: NameAlt
fields.description: Alternative description for the service code.

fields.name: NotesAlt
fields.description: Alternative notes for the service code.

system_behavior: Localization affects the display name when alternative language fields are used.
